title: Account limit changed
description: This event occurs when an account limit changes. Generated by: Update account limits More information: Account limits

total_credit_limit.title: Total credit limit
total_credit_limit.description: Old value for total credit limit amount on the account.

max_credit_limit.title: Max credit limit
max_credit_limit.description: Old value for maximum credit limit amount approved for the account.

total_overdraft_limit.title: Total overdraft limit
total_overdraft_limit.description: Old value for maximum amount approved for overdraft spending on the account.

withdrawal_credit_limit.title: Withdrawal credit limit
withdrawal_credit_limit.description: Old value for maximum withdrawal credit amount on the account.

withdrawal_percentage_limit.title: Withdrawal percentage limit
withdrawal_percentage_limit.description: Old value for the withdrawal percentage limit on the account, expressed as a fraction from `0` to `1` (inclusive). For example, the value of `0.4` in this field means 40%.

percentage_over_limit.title: Percentage over limit
percentage_over_limit.description: Old value for percentage of the maximum credit limit (max_credit_limit) made available for purchases over the credit limit on the account.

total_installment_credit_limit.title: Total installments credit limit
total_installment_credit_limit.description: Amount limit for installments in the credit account.

total_credit_limit.title: Total credit limit
total_credit_limit.description: New value for total credit limit amount on the account.

max_credit_limit.title: Max credit limit
max_credit_limit.description: New value for maximum credit limit amount approved for the account.

total_overdraft_limit.title: Total overdraft limit
total_overdraft_limit.description: New value for maximum amount approved for overdraft spending on the account.

withdrawal_credit_limit.title: Withdrawal credit limit
withdrawal_credit_limit.description: New value for maximum withdrawal credit amount on the account.

withdrawal_percentage_limit.title: Withdrawal percentage limit
withdrawal_percentage_limit.description: New value for the withdrawal percentage limit on the account, expressed as a fraction from `0` to `1` (inclusive). For example, the value of `0.4` in this field means 40%.

percentage_over_limit.title: Percentage over limit
percentage_over_limit.description: New value for percentage of the maximum credit limit (`max_credit_limit`) made available for purchases over the credit limit on the account.
